plain: Meant to calm anger or make peace

webster.text: Tending to conciliate, or reconcile; tending to make peace between persons at variance; pacific.

example.quote: It was he said a conciliatory plan, it had been considered in all its parts, a great deal of time had been spent on it, and if any part should now be altered, it would be necessary to go over the whole ground again.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 14, 1787
